facts.claim: AI apps hold a 41% year-one realised LTV premium: 30.16 dollars median against 21.37 for non-AI apps
facts.excerpt: AI apps sustain a 41% Year 1 realized LTV premium ($30.16 median vs $21.37 median).

facts.claim: A weekly plan with a trial is the highest-LTV paywall configuration at 49.27 dollars over twelve months
facts.excerpt: Weekly+trial is the highest-LTV paywall configuration at $49.27 over 12 months.

facts.claim: Monthly plans retain about 65% at day 30, 43% at day 90 and 17% at one year
facts.excerpt: For monthly plans, day 30 retention is approximately 65%, day 90 approximately 43%, and one-year approximately 17%.

facts.claim: Travel and Business lead annual renewal at a 40% median while Productivity and Photo & Video sit at 23%
facts.excerpt: Travel and Business apps see the highest median annual subscription renewal rate (40%); Productivity and Photo & Video see the lowest (23%).

facts.claim: Monthly churn of 5% to 12% is typical for mobile subscription apps, with the best holding under 5%
facts.excerpt: For mobile subscription apps, monthly churn of 5-12% is typical, with the best apps under 5%.
